profile_text.body:
Blender Foundation is a non-profit open-source foundation based around Blender, which it describes as free and open source 3D creation software. The software covers a broad range of production tasks including rendering, camera and object tracking, rigging, animation, and 2D drawing in a 3D viewport, and it exposes a Python API that allows users to build or install community-made add-ons. Blender is a member of ASWF, Khronos, the Linux Foundation, and OIN, and the foundation counts AMD, Apple, Intel, NVIDIA, and Qualcomm among its hardware supporters.

On the AI side, the site tracks a category of third-party AI add-ons for Blender described as 3D creation AI plugins that run local processing, are open-source, and carry model provenance that varies by individual plugin. A notable rendering development is the Cycles Texture Cache feature arriving in Blender 5.2 LTS, which the site says will make rendering scenes with many image textures significantly more memory efficient. No litigation, patent filings, or MCP server registrations are recorded for the foundation in the held facts.
